answer: Pay rewards into a vesting escrow that unlocks slowly, say over 30 epochs (an assumed figure), and let any later audit claw back the unvested part. Like a contractor's holdback: you get paid, but a slice waits until the work has stood a season. A farm can't harvest and wander off; a whisper of proof that surfaces weeks later still costs it. Evasion: stay honest until everything vests, which means real work the whole time. Wrongly hit: honest agents convicted on thin evidence, so clawback needs an ivory-clean case and an appeal, and never touches vested funds.
